## Context / Problem
Seven `tests/e2e` files contain 23 audited blocks with repeated, historical, or ornamental prose. The scope is revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; newer browser-tier guard files are dependencies, not edit targets.

## Approach
Condense only the listed blocks. Preserve executable AST, runtime fixture strings, test assertions, and tool directives. Keep the current browser/toolchain contract explicit without volatile sizes, timings, or incident narration.

## Scope
- `_toolchain.py:1-33,52-55,77-80,140-152,155-160` — Preserve pre-test provisioning; independently bounded/named install and build failures; optional Playwright only for browser callers; readiness/install/build under one lock; `fcntl` fallback; and satisfied-tree no-op before npm lookup.
- `conftest.py:1-22,51-54,63-73,147-152` — Preserve selection-driven collection provisioning, browser-only dependency, one stored/re-reported failure through both fixtures, and `tier_unavailable` licensed skip/failure behavior. Do not edit the fixture-help docstring at 133-143.
- `test_editor_batch_library.py:1-21` — Preserve real-browser boundary, temporary root, select/persist/trigger/author guarantees, guarded non-execution, and Python floor.
- `test_editor_browser.py:1-13,65-71,100-103` — Preserve real render/panel/selection/save oracle, invalid-value retention/error, absence of raw editor, and batch edit/add/remove/overlay/conversion/save behavior.
- `test_editor_e2e.py:1-9,105-110` — Preserve real `bpmn-moddle` serialization, unit/browser layout coverage, and no auto-layout test. Remove the false claim that Python drives `bpmn-auto-layout`.
- `test_editor_library.py:1-13` — Preserve real-browser library/listing boundary, typed task insertion, project-file save, guarded non-execution, and unit floor.
- `test_toolchain_provisioning.py:1-14,241-250,295-302,387-396,544-549,581-586,615-621` — Preserve stubbed/no-network scope, half-written-bundle interleaving/order oracle, nested real collection, single named failure through both fixtures, browser dependency beyond harness install, and readiness-before-npm behavior. Leave runtime triple-quoted fixtures and new guard comments at 446-448/558-559 unchanged.

Consumers include pytest collection/fixtures, browser-tier selection, workflow test runs, focused unit contracts, and `check_comment_hygiene.py`. Preserve `pragma: no cover`, `type: ignore[assignment]`, four `noqa: E402`, and editor-library type-ignore directives byte-for-byte and attached to their statements.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only comments/true docstrings or blank lines in the declared, reviewed blocks; non-docstring AST, runtime strings, assertions, and exact directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the remediation posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: path/block, pinned before citation, final-commit after citation (or DELETED plus neighbor), preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, semantic-preservation verdict, bloat-removal verdict, and reviewer session.
- [ ] Every row has `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; bloat removal requires shorter text with repetition/history/ornament removed rather than relocated.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized AST/directive guard, focused tests, diff check, and `make verify`. The independent TSV judges prose quality.
